assumptions.gear: 11 slots, entry-tier, mid-roll; no guardian, mastery or manual actions
assumptions.idle: all branches; 3 deterministic identities; 50%/75% red; supplied stock; 6h
assumptions.party: 6 dungeons × 3 rosters × 3 gear levels × 5 actual repeats; HP carried; owned potion cost, not free refill
assumptions.limits: Model, not observed future player win rates. 25% red settings, missing supplies and under-tier gear may cause deaths.
